SFP.Highlight.Name: Speaker highlight
SFP.Highlight.Hint: Draws a glowing frame around whoever is speaking.
SFP.Color.Name: Highlight color
SFP.Color.Hint: Color of the speaking frame, in hex (e.g. #E2B866).
SFP.Width.Name: Frame thickness
SFP.Width.Hint: Thickness of the speaking frame, in pixels.
SFP.Dim.Name: Dim who is not speaking
SFP.Dim.Hint: How much to darken the cameras of people who are not speaking. 0 = off.
SFP.Missing: SnapFrame Premium needs the SnapFrame module installed and enabled.
SFP.MicDetect.Name: Detect my voice with my microphone
SFP.MicDetect.Hint: Listens to your microphone only to know when you are speaking (works with Discord). No audio is sent to anyone.
SFP.MicThreshold.Name: Microphone sensitivity
SFP.MicThreshold.Hint: Volume needed to count as speaking, in dB. Lower = more sensitive. If it lights up with background noise, raise it.
SFP.MicDenied: SnapFrame Premium: microphone access was denied, so your voice will not light up your frame.
SFP.NoTable: SnapFrame Premium: there is no active camera table in this scene.
SFP.Portrait.Name: Character portrait in the corner
SFP.Portrait.Hint: Shows each player's linked character portrait in a corner of their camera.
SFP.Corner.Name: Portrait corner
SFP.Corner.Hint: Which corner of the camera shows the portrait.
SFP.PSize.Name: Portrait size
SFP.PSize.Hint: Portrait diameter as a share of the camera's height.
SFP.When.Name: Show portrait
SFP.When.Hint: Only when the camera is on (when it's off, the character image already fills the frame) or always.
SFP.Editor.Marker: Character portrait: drag to move, mouse wheel to resize, right-click to reset to the default corner.
